nepal.title: DGO Nepal Subscription Terms and Conditions
nepal.scope: One-time prepaid subscriptions for Nepal, including additions of time to the exact current plan.
nepal.preamble: Please read these terms before you pay. By completing a Nepal subscription purchase on DGO, you agree to them.

sections.title: 1. Who we are and when these terms apply
sections.body:
These terms govern Nepal prepaid DGO subscription purchases and additions of time to an existing Nepal plan. DGO is provided by DishHome Digital Pvt. Ltd., registered at Chyasikot, Lalitpur, with registration number 384546/8283 and PAN or VAT number 623538638 (“we”, “us” or “DGO”). Contact us at support@watchdgo.com or through the official social channels linked from our website.

Your order confirmation identifies the seller, plan, payment amount, and access period. These terms apply together with the plan details shown before payment and our Privacy Policy at https://www.watchdgo.com/en/page/privacy-policy. Mandatory consumer rights and applicable purchase-channel requirements take priority over any inconsistent provision.

sections.title: 2. Your plan and access
sections.body:
Before paying, check the plan tier, duration, total price, compatible devices, simultaneous streams, content availability and territorial restrictions. Mobile provides access on supported phones and tablets, without TV viewing or casting. Plus provides the additional supported devices and streams described at checkout. One-month plans do not include live sports; the available three-month and twelve-month plans include the live sports specified for that plan and territory.

A new subscription starts when payment is successfully verified and access is activated. We will provide confirmation showing your access end date. Payment authorisation alone does not establish that access has been activated. Contact us promptly if you are charged but access is not provided.

sections.title: 3. Prices and one-time payment
sections.body:
Nepal subscriptions are prepaid and do not renew automatically. You pay the total amount shown at checkout in Nepalese rupees for the selected term. A monthly equivalent is a comparison figure, not a monthly instalment. Applicable taxes and any charges collected by DGO will be disclosed before you confirm payment.

You may pay using the payment methods offered at checkout. Payment partners may apply their own disclosed terms. Coupon eligibility, expiry and any restrictions will be shown with the offer. We do not guarantee that a promotional price will remain available for a future purchase. A later price change does not alter time already purchased.

sections.title: 4. Adding time to your current plan
sections.body:
While your Nepal subscription is active, Add time is available only for the exact current plan, with the same tier and duration. For example, an active Plus three-month plan can be extended by purchasing that same Plus three-month plan. Selecting another tier or duration does not qualify as adding time.

After successful payment, the purchased duration is added to your existing expiry date. It does not replace or shorten your remaining access, change your entitlement or create automatic renewal. The price and any eligible discount are those shown for that purchase. Your confirmation will show the updated expiry date.

A different subscription cannot be purchased while your current Nepal plan remains active, except through the support-assisted process in section 6. After expiry, a new purchase starts a fresh term.

sections.title: 5. Refunds and wrong-package purchases
sections.body:
Subject to applicable law and purchase-channel rules, we do not ordinarily refund a correctly supplied subscription solely because you change your mind, do not use it, or later prefer another plan. This does not limit remedies for a service that is not supplied, faulty, materially misdescribed or otherwise fails to meet legal requirements, or for an unauthorised or erroneous charge.

As an additional voluntary concession, you may request a wrong-package refund within 24 hours of the transaction timestamp. Provide your registered phone or email, User ID, transaction ID and payment reference. The payment and account details must match our records. We will review the circumstances and explain our decision. This concession is limited to one approved accidental-purchase refund per account per calendar year.

The 24-hour window and annual limit apply only to this voluntary concession. They do not restrict statutory remedies, payment-provider dispute rights or remedies required by an applicable store. A refund for an Add time purchase, where approved or required, removes only the time attributable to the refunded purchase, unless another remedy is legally required.

sections.title: 6. Support-assisted upgrades
sections.body:
Contact support before purchasing a different plan during an active term. If you choose to proceed with an approved support-assisted upgrade, we will explain the proposed removal of your current entitlement and the treatment of its payment or remaining access before seeking your agreement. There is no automatic proration or self-service tier change.

After support removes the existing entitlement, the upgraded plan must be purchased using the same User ID within 12 hours to meet the voluntary upgrade arrangement. This window begins on removal, not on your initial enquiry. We will confirm the removal time. If a DGO or payment-system fault prevents completion, contact support for review. Missing this window does not extinguish statutory rights.

sections.title: 7. Refund processing and payment questions
sections.body:
Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method wherever possible. We aim to initiate a voluntary refund within five to seven business days after approval; your payment provider may take additional time to credit it. Any legally required deadline takes priority.

For a discretionary refund only, any proposed deduction of an actual, non-recoverable gateway fee will be explained before you accept the refund and applied only where lawful and permitted by the payment provider. We do not deduct fees where you are legally entitled to a full refund.

Please contact support if you do not recognise a charge or believe a payment has been duplicated or incorrectly processed. You may also exercise rights available through your bank, payment provider, regulator or a court. Contacting DGO first is encouraged but is not a condition of those rights.

sections.title: 8. Availability and service problems
sections.body:
Content availability depends on territorial rights, schedules and licensing. We will describe material restrictions before purchase and will not knowingly sell access to content unavailable under the advertised plan in your territory. Titles and schedules may change, subject to your contractual and statutory rights.

We maintain and update the service and may need to interrupt access for maintenance, security or technical reasons. Report faults to support with your User ID, device details and the time of the problem. We will investigate and provide a remedy required by law, which may include restoring access, an appropriate price reduction or a refund.

For a continuous DGO platform failure lasting more than 48 hours, affected customers may additionally request an appropriate time extension or account credit. This service concession does not require a worldwide outage and does not postpone or replace any remedy otherwise due.

sections.title: 9. Account use and security
sections.body:
You must be legally able to enter this contract or have a parent or guardian make the purchase. Keep your account and payment information accurate and your credentials secure. Use the service for personal, non-commercial viewing within the plan limits. Do not resell access, unlawfully copy or redistribute content, or bypass access controls or territorial restrictions.

We may restrict access where reasonably necessary to address fraud, unlawful use, a material breach or a security threat. We will explain the reason and offer a way to seek review where lawful and practicable. Raising a genuine billing complaint or payment dispute does not by itself justify permanent suspension.

sections.title: 10. Purchases through apps and other channels
sections.body:
The checkout and receipt identify who processes your payment. A purchase completed on DGO's website after leaving an app is a direct purchase; its billing and refund requests are handled by DGO and the identified payment provider. Merely downloading an app from Apple or Google does not make a website purchase an Apple or Google purchase.

If you purchase through Apple or Google billing, use that provider's subscription or refund process where applicable. Its transaction rules and applicable law govern that purchase in addition to DGO's service terms. These terms do not authorise payment methods or links that are not permitted for the relevant app, country or storefront.

sections.title: 11. Privacy, records and complaints
sections.body:
Our Privacy Policy explains how we use account, payment-reference, device and viewing data, and how you can exercise applicable privacy rights. We use payment and service records to investigate access, billing and refund questions. These records may be evidence, but are not automatically conclusive and may be challenged or corrected.

Send complaints to support@watchdgo.com with your account details, the issue and the resolution requested. Do not send your full card number, password or payment PIN. We will acknowledge and investigate your complaint and explain the outcome. You remain free to approach the competent consumer authority, payment provider or court.

sections.title: 12. Responsibility and mandatory rights
sections.body:
We are responsible for losses caused by our breach of contract or failure to meet applicable legal duties to the extent required by law. We do not exclude liability for fraud, wilful misconduct, death or personal injury caused by negligence, or any liability that cannot lawfully be excluded. Your rights under Nepal's applicable consumer protection and electronic commerce laws remain unaffected.

We are not responsible for a problem caused solely by your unsupported equipment or internet provider where the service was accurately described and correctly supplied. This does not remove our obligation to investigate a reported fault or provide remedies where we are responsible.

sections.title: 13. Changes, governing law and agreement
sections.body:
We may update these terms for legal, security or service reasons. We will notify you of material changes that affect an existing purchase. Changes will not retrospectively remove accrued rights or reduce prepaid access without your agreement or an appropriate remedy. New prices apply only to a future purchase accepted by you.

These terms are governed by Nepal law, subject to any mandatory consumer protections that also apply. You may bring a claim before a competent court or authority. If a provision is unenforceable, the remaining provisions continue to apply to the extent lawful.

sections.title: 14. Checkout acknowledgement
sections.body: I have read and agree to the DGO Nepal Subscription Terms and Conditions. I understand that this is a one-time payment without automatic renewal. For Add time, the purchased duration will be added to my existing expiry date. Refund conditions apply without limiting my statutory rights.

nepal.acknowledgement: I have read and agree to the DGO Nepal Subscription Terms and Conditions. I understand that this is a one-time payment without automatic renewal. For Add time, the purchased duration will be added to my existing expiry date. Refund conditions apply without limiting my statutory rights.

international.title: DGO International Subscription Terms and Conditions
international.scope: Recurring subscriptions for customers outside Nepal, including purchases billed directly through Stripe.
international.preamble: These terms apply to recurring DGO subscriptions purchased by customers outside Nepal, including purchases billed directly through Stripe. Please read them together with the plan and payment information displayed before you subscribe.

sections.title: 1. Who sells the subscription and what applies
sections.body:
These terms govern international recurring subscriptions sold by DGO Digital Limited, a company registered in England and Wales with company number 08282737 and registered office at Pentax House, South Hill Avenue, South Harrow, Harrow, HA2 0DU ("DGO", "we", "us" or "our"). Our customer-support contact is support@watchdgo.com.

The contracting seller and payment provider are identified at checkout or in your order confirmation. These terms apply alongside the plan details accepted at checkout and our Privacy Policy at https://www.watchdgo.com/en/page/privacy-policy. If any mandatory consumer protection applies in your country, these terms do not remove it. A pricing zone, currency or payment provider alone does not determine which consumer law applies.

sections.title: 2. Plans, devices, content and territorial access
sections.body:
The plan description shown before purchase specifies your subscription tier, duration, supported devices, simultaneous streams and included benefits. A Mobile plan is intended for compatible phones and tablets and does not include television viewing or casting. A Plus plan permits the additional supported devices and streams identified for that plan at checkout. Device compatibility, system requirements and access limits may change only subject to your contractual and statutory rights.

Unless expressly stated otherwise for a particular plan, one-month international plans do not include live sports; eligible three-month and twelve-month plans include only the live sports expressly described for the plan and territory at checkout. No event, league, film or programme is guaranteed unless specifically represented as available for your purchase.

Content rights, titles, schedules, languages and availability can differ by territory and may change. Access while travelling or relocating may be restricted by licensing rules, subject to applicable cross-border portability rights and other mandatory law. We will identify material territorial or content limitations before purchase and will not knowingly sell a plan using a materially misleading description of availability.

Your subscription normally starts once payment has been verified and the purchased entitlement has been activated. We will confirm the plan and billing period. If payment is captured but the promised access is not provided, contact us so we can correct the issue and provide the remedy required by law.

sections.title: 3. Pricing, currencies, taxes and billing periods
sections.body:
Before you place an order, checkout will display the total amount payable, payment currency, billing frequency, applicable taxes and DGO charges, and any relevant trial or promotional conditions. Where a monthly equivalent is displayed for comparison, it is not a monthly payment option. A three-month plan is charged for the complete three-month billing period and a twelve-month plan for the complete annual billing period.

DGO may maintain a base catalogue price in US dollars while allowing eligible customers to pay in another currency. Where local-currency pricing or currency conversion is offered, the exchange rate used may include a disclosed conversion markup or fee. For recurring subscriptions with exchange-rate-based local pricing, the amount charged in your selected payment currency may change at renewal when exchange rates change, even if DGO has not changed the base plan price. The checkout and payment confirmation will explain the currency arrangement applicable to your purchase.

A change in exchange rates is distinct from a change in DGO’s underlying plan price. Any change in our underlying price will be handled under section 14, including any notice or consent required by law. Your bank, issuer or payment provider may separately charge foreign-exchange or cross-border fees under its own terms. If a promotion or introductory price expires, we will disclose the subsequent price or pricing basis and when it will apply before you subscribe.

sections.title: 4. Automatic renewal and payment authorisation
sections.body:
Unless you cancel renewal, your subscription renews automatically at the billing interval shown at checkout. By purchasing, you authorise DGO and the relevant payment provider to charge your selected payment method for the first payment and subsequent authorised renewals, subject to any applicable notice, consent or cancellation requirements.

For direct subscriptions, Stripe processes the payment on behalf of the DGO contracting seller identified in your order. Keep your payment details current. We will provide payment and contract confirmations, as well as renewal reminders, cooling-off notices and change notices to the extent required by applicable law and payment-network rules.

If a renewal payment fails, we may retry it in line with the disclosed billing arrangement and the payment provider’s rules. Access may be paused or ended if payment remains unsuccessful. A failed payment does not remove your right to cancel future renewal, request correction of a billing error or dispute an unauthorised charge.

sections.title: 5. Cancellation, renewal settings and access expiry
sections.body:
For a subscription purchased directly from DGO, you can switch off automatic renewal at any time through the subscription-management controls in your DGO account. You do not need to email us, obtain support approval, give a reason or contact us by telephone. The cancellation control will show the action and allow you to confirm it directly in the platform. If the controls are unavailable or do not work, you may contact support@watchdgo.com for assistance; support is a fallback, not a required step for normal cancellation.

Once you confirm the cancellation in the platform, automatic renewal is switched off and the cancellation takes effect immediately for future billing. We will display or send confirmation, including your access end date. A system processing delay does not by itself undo a cancellation confirmed before a renewal charge. Ordinarily, you can continue viewing until the end of your existing paid billing period, without a further renewal charge. If you separately exercise a statutory withdrawal right, terminate for breach or obtain a refund, the treatment of access and payments may differ under applicable law.

Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription. Deleting your DGO account and cancelling recurring billing are different actions. If you request account deletion, we will explain and arrange the treatment of an associated direct subscription, including any cancellation rights. Turning off renewal does not, by itself, create a refund entitlement for an otherwise correctly supplied paid period; section 7 and mandatory law continue to apply.

sections.title: 6. Upgrades, downgrades and resuming renewal
sections.body:
Before you agree to change plans, we will show the resulting tier and benefits, price, effective date, any immediate charge or credit, renewal interval and any change to the billing date. Immediate upgrades may generate a prorated charge or credit for unused time. Changing the billing interval may start a new billing period. Only the amount and timing presented for your confirmation will be authorised.

A scheduled downgrade normally takes effect at the next renewal date without an immediate charge, unless the confirmation states otherwise. If automatic renewal has already been switched off, we will explain whether a proposed change would restart it and obtain your affirmative agreement before charging for any resumed renewal.

sections.title: 7. Cooling-off rights, refunds and mandatory remedies
sections.body:
We do not ordinarily refund a correctly supplied subscription merely because you did not use it, changed your mind after any applicable cancellation period, or forgot to stop a valid renewal. This does not restrict any refund, withdrawal, termination, price reduction or other remedy you have under applicable law, the rules of your purchase channel or an express DGO offer.

For many UK and EEA distance purchases, an initial statutory cancellation or withdrawal period of 14 days may apply. Some subscriptions and renewals may have additional cancellation rights. The precise period, exceptions and financial consequences depend on the applicable law and the legal classification of the service. We will provide any required pre-contract explanation, cancellation method and confirmation.

Starting a streaming subscription during a cooling-off period does not automatically remove your statutory cancellation or withdrawal rights. In particular, where a streaming subscription is legally treated as a digital service, the rules for digital services apply and the digital-content exception must not be assumed to apply. If applicable law permits charging for service provided before a valid withdrawal, any such amount will be determined only as law allows, including any requirements for your express request for early supply and the relevant disclosures.

Where a separate loss-of-withdrawal-right consent is legally permitted for a qualifying supply of digital content, we will request the required express consent and acknowledgement separately from general acceptance of these terms and provide any required durable confirmation. Such consent will never remove mandatory rights concerning faulty, inaccessible or materially misdescribed content or your ability to stop future renewal.

UK customers retain applicable UK consumer protections; EEA customers retain their applicable national consumer rights under EU-derived law; Australian customers retain guarantees and remedies under the Australian Consumer Law; and customers elsewhere retain the mandatory protections that apply to them. No clause in these terms excludes rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.

sections.title: 8. Refund requests, charges and payment disputes
sections.body:
For a refund, billing correction or payment enquiry, email support@watchdgo.com with your account email or User ID, order reference if available, approximate transaction date and an explanation of the issue. Do not send card numbers, passwords or security codes. We will review the request, explain our decision and process any refund required by law or otherwise approved.

Approved refunds are ordinarily returned to the original payment method. We aim to initiate discretionary refunds promptly after approval; the time for the funds to appear depends on the payment provider or issuer. Any mandatory refund deadline takes priority. We will not deduct fees from a refund where the law requires the full amount to be returned. Any proposed lawful deduction for a discretionary refund will be explained before it is accepted.

You may contact us first about an unfamiliar or incorrect charge, but you do not need to exhaust our support process before exercising rights through your bank, payment provider, consumer authority or a court. We may provide relevant records in a dispute. A good-faith complaint or genuine chargeback does not, by itself, justify permanent account suspension.

sections.title: 9. Service faults, availability and changes
sections.body:
DGO may occasionally interrupt service for maintenance, upgrades, security or technical reasons. Report a fault with the account details, device and approximate time of the issue. We will investigate reasonably and provide remedies required by applicable law, which may include restored access, a price reduction, termination or a refund.

We may offer extensions or credits as goodwill in appropriate cases, but no customer needs to wait for a specified outage duration before exercising a legal remedy. Where a material change significantly reduces the service that was promised at purchase, we will provide appropriate notice and any right to reject the change, terminate or receive a refund required by law. Licensing constraints do not excuse a materially misleading representation made at checkout.

sections.title: 10. Account security and acceptable use
sections.body:
You must have legal capacity to enter into this agreement, or a parent or guardian must make the purchase where legally required. Keep your information accurate and your login credentials secure. DGO is for personal, non-commercial viewing within the limits of your plan. You must not resell access, unlawfully copy or redistribute content, bypass access controls, or use DGO for unlawful purposes.

We may reasonably restrict or suspend access to respond to fraud, a security threat, unlawful activity or a material breach. Where lawful and practical, we will explain the reason and offer a way to request review. Any consequences for prepaid fees remain subject to mandatory consumer rights.

sections.title: 11. Website purchases and app-store purchases
sections.body:
A subscription purchased and paid for on DGO’s website is a direct purchase, even if you reached the website from an app. For direct purchases, use the DGO cancellation, billing and refund options described in these terms, without prejudice to rights against a payment provider.

If your purchase is billed by Apple or Google, follow the store’s subscription-management and refund process. The applicable store rules and mandatory consumer protections govern that transaction alongside the relevant DGO service terms. Your receipt identifies the billing provider. Nothing in these terms authorises payment arrangements that a relevant platform, country or storefront prohibits.

sections.title: 12. Privacy, customer support and complaints
sections.body:
Our Privacy Policy at https://www.watchdgo.com/en/page/privacy-policy describes our handling of account information, payment references, devices, viewing information and applicable privacy rights. Service and payment records may be used to investigate complaints or establish which plan was purchased and supplied; records are not automatically conclusive and may be challenged or corrected.

For a complaint, email support@watchdgo.com with the relevant facts and the resolution requested. We will acknowledge the complaint, investigate it and explain our outcome. You retain access to any competent regulator, consumer body, alternative dispute-resolution scheme or court available under applicable law.

sections.title: 13. Responsibility and limitations
sections.body:
We remain responsible for losses caused by our breach of contract or failure to meet legal duties to the extent required by applicable law. Nothing limits or excludes liability for fraud, wilful misconduct, death or personal injury caused by negligence, or any liability that cannot lawfully be limited or excluded. Applicable consumer guarantees and remedies remain unaffected.

We are not responsible for faults caused solely by incompatible equipment or a customer’s internet connection where our service was accurately described and correctly supplied. We will nevertheless reasonably investigate reported issues and provide any remedy for which we are legally responsible.

sections.title: 14. Changes to subscription prices and terms
sections.body:
We may make reasonable changes to these terms or the service for legal, security, technical or service-related reasons. If a material change affects your subscription, we will give the advance notice required by law, explain the change and provide any right to reject it, cancel or obtain a remedy. We will obtain consent where required before a change takes effect.

A change to our underlying subscription price will not alter an already paid billing period. Before a new underlying price takes effect at renewal, we will identify the new price or legally permitted pricing basis, its effective date and how to cancel, and give any additional notice required by law. Changes attributable solely to exchange-rate movements under an agreed local-currency arrangement are explained in section 3; applicable disclosure and consumer rights still apply. We will not remove accrued rights retrospectively.

sections.title: 15. Governing law and general provisions
sections.body:
These terms are governed by the laws of England and Wales, except that this choice does not deprive you of mandatory consumer protections that apply in the country where you habitually reside. You may bring a claim in any court or before any authority having jurisdiction under applicable law. These terms do not impose an exclusive UK forum where doing so would restrict your consumer rights.

If a provision cannot lawfully be enforced, the remaining provisions continue to apply to the extent permitted. A failure to enforce a term on one occasion does not waive its future enforcement. These terms, the accepted plan information and the order confirmation describe the subscription contract, without excluding pre-contract statements or obligations that the law makes binding.

sections.title: 16. Cancellation and withdrawal notice
sections.body:
To stop future automatic renewal of a direct DGO subscription, use the self-service control in your DGO account as described in section 5; no email is necessary. The example notice below is for a separate statutory right to cancel or withdraw from the subscription contract, not for ordinary renewal cancellation. Where applicable, you may exercise that right by sending a clear notice to support@watchdgo.com or our registered office before the relevant deadline. No particular wording is required.

To DGO: I give notice that I cancel / withdraw from my subscription contract.
Order date: [date]
Account email or User ID: [details]
Customer name and address: [details]
Date of notice: [date]
Signature: [only if posted on paper]

This model notice is optional. The cancellation method and any right to a refund depend on the applicable law and the circumstances of your purchase.

sections.title: 17. Checkout acknowledgement
sections.body: I have read and agree to the DGO International Subscription Terms and Conditions. I understand that my subscription renews automatically at the billing interval shown until I switch off renewal in my DGO account, and that cancellation, cooling-off and refund rights apply as described in these terms, without limiting my statutory rights.
